test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Figure A is related to B in a certain pattern. Following the same pattern, figure C is related to D. Study the pattern and select the figure which should be placed in place of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68f497b2d305fb09621b7ad5af29aef8652e7ff97d8707378f853a97902ca5b5.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• Letter at the left down corner is flipped horizontally and shifted to the opposite side i.e right up corner.
 
• figures at the left up corner and right down corner are rotated 90º in the clockwise direction.
 
• The center element is doubled. 

So, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd9c97c17b080f54129a0ec0335a9fce6c76479e6686c4c1f4d16c566de1e976.png] 

 
• Figures A and B ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/217ab7b51c251c7ac3e51ff6ceede08ae1f1bf9b745cd2eb309762a09f8f67ce.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• Figure C and D **⇒** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9d9baff13019becf9ef08ecfcec06deffe2cf62dff6acb9bf1e76e5029118b0.png] **​**

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
